title: Relay stats: show slicer's relay-run stats in ork instead of computing them
lead: Re-spec of S123. ork shows the output of `slicer relay-run stats --json` (runs and outcomes, fix rounds, gate FAILs, role times, owner wait) and computes none of it. Where it shows is an open owner question; the slicer wrapper and its types are common to every placement.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Retrospective R2 and R4 (`docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md:65` and `:109`; Appendix A at `:253`) worked out run time, fix rounds, role times and idle gaps by hand from `slicer relay-run list --json`. R4 asks whether the implementer self-check (S115) lowers the fix-round rate and R2 targets owner wait time, so the owner wants these numbers on hand. The original S123 said to compute them in ork from the ledger.

That duplicates slicer. `slicer relay-run stats [--since DATE]` exists (slicer s408, done, pass v1.17; `../slicer/docs/commands.md:78`; its JSON shape is `../slicer/docs/agents.md:503`). On 2026-10-31, `slicer relay-run stats --json` returned in 0.2 s: 169 runs (160 pass, 0 fail, 9 stopped, 0 unended), 163 measured, median wall time 2041 s, fix rounds 172 (111 runs with any, 36 with two or more), 144 gate rounds of which 18 FAIL (6 by recorded verdict, 138 counted by proxy), role times for implementer, reviewer, gate, architect, orchestrator, ui and ui-pass, and owner wait (4 runs, 381 s in all, median 55 s, longest 229 s). `AGENTS.md` says to check slicer before specifying an ork capability, and `docs/boundaries.md` makes the relay-run ledger slicer's. Owner, 2026-10-31: move S123 to v1.2 and re-spec it as a thin display of slicer's output.

The JSON top-level keys, in order: `since`, `runs` (`total`, `pass`, `fail`, `stopped`, `unended`), `measured`, `wall_seconds` (`median`, `max`, either may be `null`), `fix_rounds` (`total`, `runs_with_any`, `runs_with_two_or_more`), `gates` (`rounds`, `fails`, `with_verdict`, `by_proxy`), `roles` (per role: `steps`, `total_seconds`, `median_seconds`), `owner_wait` (`runs_with_wait`, `total_seconds`, `median_seconds`, `max_seconds`, `by_waiting_on` with `approval` and `owner`), `per_run` (one entry per run; the whole output is 88 KB on this repo). This slice decodes everything except `per_run` and shows none of it. Gate FAIL counts are slicer's: a recorded `fail` verdict, or for a gate with none a following fix round (`../slicer/docs/agents.md:503`); the display says "by proxy" the way slicer's text does.

Where the display lives is not decided. Options (MANIFEST-E.md, SR-Q1): an `ork stats` CLI, a panel in the TUI, a section of `ork doctor`, or several. The steps for each are in Implement; do not start them before the owner picks.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Common (`internal/slicercli/slicercli_test.go`):
- `TestRelayStatsDecodesTheRecordedOutput`: current recorded stats output decodes; compare every aggregate key to fixture; per_run ignored. Historical 169-run snapshot replaced by current recording.
- `TestRelayStatsNullMediansDecodeAsAbsent`: empty output keeps null wall/owner medians and maxima distinct from zero; roles empty.
- `TestRelayStatsPassesSinceAndRoot`: exact stats --json [--since DATE] --root ROOT routes.
- `TestRelayStatsKeepsSlicersErrorCode`: usage (exit 2) and missing ledger preserve code/message.
CLI (`internal/cli/stats_test.go`): `TestStatsPrintsTheLinesSlicerPrints`, `TestStatsJSONIsSlicersOutputWithoutPerRun`, `TestStatsSinceFlagIsPassedThrough`, `TestStatsUnknownProjectIsNotFound`, `TestStatsOlderSlicerPrintsSlicersError`, `TestStatsUsage`. Compare JSON documents key for key, and test current-directory default, empty/zero durations and help.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first.

1. Preflight: the owner has answered SR-Q1 (and SR-Q2 if the answer is a panel or doctor). If not, do only steps 2 and 3 and report; do not choose a placement.
2. `internal/slicercli`: types `RelayStats{Since *string; Runs RunOutcomes; Measured int; WallSeconds MedianMax; FixRounds ...; Gates ...; Roles map[string]RoleTime; OwnerWait ...}` with pointer ints where slicer says a value may be `null`. Tolerant decoding (unknown keys ignored), as the other slicercli types. `RelayStats(ctx, root, since)` runs `slicer relay-run stats --json --root ROOT [--since DATE]`. Check how `RelayRuns` orders its arguments (`slicercli.go:97-110`) and follow it. Do not compute or reformat anything slicer already gives; ork adds no median, sum or rate of its own.
3. Record one fixture (run the command once on this repo and keep the output without `per_run`, or the whole file if a test needs it), plus the empty-ledger output.
4. Display, for the picked placement only: print slicer's numbers with slicer's own wording where it has one (`slicer relay-run stats` text, read once to copy the labels: "fix rounds", "gates: N rounds, N FAIL; N had a recorded verdict, N counted by proxy", "owner wait"). Durations as slicer prints them (`34m01s`); do not change units. Mark the display *proposed* in the docs. Nothing is cached or stored: every call runs slicer.
5. Docs for the placement picked, and one sentence in `docs/boundaries.md` Ownership that the ledger statistics are slicer's and ork only displays them.
6. CHANGELOG entry last, under `## Unreleased`: `Relay stats (*proposed*): ...`. Add it as the final edit so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict.

Do not touch: `internal/source/source.go` (the Runs part), `internal/engine`, the ledger writes, or slicer. S123's old plan (a stats panel computed from `relay-run list`) is dropped.

UI slice: UI pass (r14), whichever placement is picked (all three change CLI output or the TUI).

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): Where does ork show slicer's relay-run stats? -> ork stats CLI: add `ork stats [PROJECT] [--since DATE] [--json]` and print what `slicer relay-run stats --json` returns. No daemon method, no goldens, N-class (no daemon or golden changes). The spec's Implement steps 4 and 5 and the Option a tests then apply as written. [stats.placement]. Which time range does the display use? (SR-Q2; matters only if the SR-Q1 answer is not option 1) -> pass-through: pass `--since` to slicer only, and show all-time by default. ork picks no window. If SR-Q1 is the CLI, this is already what the spec's `[--since DATE]` flag says. [stats.range].

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/slicercli` plus the package of the placement.
- The output of `slicer relay-run stats --json` with its per_run list removed equals the display's `--json` (option a) key for key (compare the two JSON documents in the test, not with a shell pipe).
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner reads the display against `slicer relay-run stats` and confirms the numbers match; for a TUI panel, at 100x30 and 80x24 in a live terminal.
